subject: [PATCH RESEND 6/7] Documentation/locking: document sleeping lock holder tracking

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch adds documentation to the Linux kernel's locking subsystem, specifically about sleeping lock holder tracking. The feature allows kernel code to identify tasks that are holding widely shared locks and may be causing stalls in other tasks waiting for those locks. It provides information on how a task can opt-in to being tracked, how the count is updated, and what it costs in terms of performance. The documentation also explains where each lock type updates the count and notes what is not covered by this feature.
